name: Marko Kovačić
bio:
Marko's path to motorsport began with a childhood fascination for complex systems and a knack for problem-solving. He honed his analytical skills through years of competitive chess and later, applied mathematics. After earning his degree, he initially worked as a data analyst in the logistics industry, but his passion for racing never waned. He began volunteering at local racing events, offering data-driven insights to smaller teams. This led to a full-time position as a junior strategist with a regional rally team, where he quickly demonstrated his ability to predict outcomes and formulate winning strategies under pressure.

His meticulous approach to race analysis, combined with his ability to quickly adapt to changing conditions, has earned him a reputation as a reliable and insightful strategist. Marko is known for his relentless pursuit of marginal gains, constantly seeking ways to optimize performance through data analysis and innovative thinking. He believes that a successful strategy is not just about reacting to the race, but about proactively shaping it to your advantage. His recent move to Iron Dames represents a significant step up in his career, and he's eager to prove his worth on the world stage.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Marko has a focused gaze and a wiry build that speaks to his intense concentration.
